key_catalyst: Brent crude surges above $100 as Houthi tanker attacks widen Iran-aligned conflict, driving a 7% oil spike and pushing 10-year yields to 4.70%
reasoning: Today's intraday selloff fails to fully price in the accelerating severity of multiple simultaneous crises. Oil breaking above $100 on Houthi attacks is a new threshold that reignites inflation fears and pushes yields to multi-month highs, directly compressing QQQ's growth-heavy valuations. Simultaneously, the AI capex cash-burn reality from Alphabet and Tesla is triggering a sector-wide repricing that has just begun to be digested, and the newly enacted Section 301 tariffs introduce an unresolved trade-risk premium likely to draw retaliation overnight.
